rows.derivation: Source decision: criterion 2 (primary measurements) selects Shornikov (2017), Table 2, Knudsen ΔfusH = 55.81 ± 4.62 kJ/mol compound over the JANAF Al-090 analogy estimate of 46 ± 5 kcal/mol = 192.464 ± 20.92 kJ/mol. Shornikov reports a direct compound-molar measurement and the smaller stated uncertainty; the independent Richet et al. DTA value is 53.50 ± 5.50 kJ/mol. JANAF Al-090 prints “Be2O4(l)”; reading the seven-gram-atom construction as BeAl2O4 is an inference, not a verified page transcription. Criterion 1 keeps JANAF Al-089 MgAl2O4(cr) for the crystal phase pair. Retain JANAF Al-090 Tfus = 2408 ± 20 K; the measured 2416 ± 10 K and 2420 ± 25 K ranges overlap. Using 2420 K instead would increase the JANAF-minus-measured Gibbs gap by 0.478, 0.563, 0.619 kJ/mol at 1700, 2000, and 2200 K. Build G(MgAl2O4,l;T)=G(cr,T)+ΔfusG(T), retaining JANAF Al-090 Cp(l)=52.5 cal mol^-1 K^-1 = 219.66 J mol^-1 K^-1 above Tg=1750 K and the crystal Cp below Tg. For the constant-ΔCp branch above Tg, ΔfusG(T)=ΔHfus(1−T/Tm)+ΔCp[(T−Tm)−T ln(T/Tm)]; below Tg the liquid uses the crystal Cp branch. In the JANAF-versus-corrected comparison, this common Cp/Tg term cancels, leaving ΔG=(192.464−55.81)(1−T/2408) kJ/mol. FC87 Appendix 1 R1-R6 derives log10K=A+B/T from JANAF; lowering product G by ΔG raises log10K by ΔG/(RT ln 10), so ΔB=136.654 kJ/mol divided by R ln 10 = 7137.933123955643 K and ΔA=−ΔB/Tm=−2.9642579418420448. Thus A=−1.7842579418420448 and B=7601.933123955643 for row 3. Units: R=8.31446261815324 J mol^-1 K^-1=0.00831446261815324 kJ mol^-1 K^-1, so kJ/mol divided by R gives kelvin for ΔB; ΔA is dimensionless and the Cp bracket has units of kelvin. Sanity: ΔGfus(2408 K)=0 and the JANAF liquid-G bias is 40.179, 23.154, 11.804 kJ/mol at 1700, 2000, and 2200 K.

For FeO(l), the selected Darken and Gurry (1946) iron-saturated equilibria reduced via Masson (1965) give dG = 27778.965828 - 10.961554232*T J/mol; this shift is applied to FeO(l), the FeO1.5 oxidation reaction, and Fe-bearing associations. MgAl2O4 row 3 uses Shornikov (2017) Delta_fus_H = 55.81 +/- 4.62 kJ/mol with JANAF Al-089 crystal and Al-090 fusion/Cp. FeAl2O4 row 21 retains its FC87 R21 estimates; redox homologue statistics and the condensate FeO(l) row are updated consistently.
Corrected the FeTiO3, Fe2SiO4, and FeAl2O4 source statements to identify the Darken and Gurry/Masson FeO(l) re-anchor as part of the default pack.
Added source_refs to every default melt row and DOI fields to the referenced source inventory. source_refs is provenance metadata; it does not alter the numerical coefficients.
Promotes measured SiO2(l) and Na2O(l) heat capacities; the prior default 1.0.5-d066-v3 remains available by file id.
Refits the seven Sr candidate rows through 3000 K; v1 and the default D066 v4 pack are unchanged.

feo_liquid_candidate.source: Source decision: criterion 2 (primary measurements) selects the Darken & Gurry (1946) iron-saturated equilibria, reduced via Masson (1965), over JANAF Fe-019’s 1965 construction. Fe-019 assigns wustite fusion to O2 release at 1 bar. Residuals are reported and never gate this source choice. Darken & Gurry (1946), Tables IIIA/B/VI; Masson (1965), Eq. 17
feo_liquid_candidate.transformation: For each association consuming nu_FeO FeO(l), preserve the complex standard Gibbs energy: log10(K_new/K_old)=nu_FeO*DeltaG_FeO/(R*T*ln(10)); equivalently add nu_FeO*c1/(R ln 10) to A and nu_FeO*c0/(R ln 10) to B.
feo_liquid_candidate.uncertainty: Darken & Gurry report no formal pointwise activity uncertainty; the adopted source correction is fixed and its anchor residuals are reported without using them as a selection gate.

SiO2.source: Richet, Bottinga & Tequi (1984), J. Am. Ceram. Soc. 67, C-6–C-8
SiO2.transfer_note: Measured sodium-silicate partial heat capacity; extrapolated above 1800 K and transferred to multicomponent melts.

Na2O.source: Richet, Bottinga & Tequi (1984), J. Am. Ceram. Soc. 67, C-6–C-8
Na2O.transfer_note: Measured sodium-silicate partial heat capacity; extrapolated above 1800 K and transferred beyond the measured sodium-silicate composition range.

parent_standard_candidates.construction: G_l(T)=G_s(T_m)−S_s(T_m)(T−T_m)+ΔH_fus(1−T/T_m)+Cp_l[(T−T_m)−T ln(T/T_m)]; terms are J/mol, converted to kJ/mol for apparent G.

SrO.transfer_note: Direct JANAF liquid Gibbs reference; used as a metastable liquid standard where SrO is not stable as a pure liquid.

candidate_provenance.status: opt-in provisional candidate; not the default
candidate_provenance.source_policy: Only the listed printed values are transcribed. No optimized SrO-Al2O3 liquid interaction parameters are included.
candidate_provenance.basis: SrO is a full component only under this candidate model identity.
candidate_provenance.reference_fit: Each row is refit to this pack's liquid standards by least squares on 1001 evenly spaced temperatures from 1700 to 3000 K, using pointwise log10 K and the basis [1, 1/T].
candidate_provenance.fusion: All seven liquid associates use the class-C estimate 8.297530569 J mol^-1 formula atom^-1 K^-1 times total formula atoms. This is provisional. Liquid Cp for the four newly built aluminates is the additive parent liquid Cp at the selected fusion marker.

brisi_entropies.assumption: For Sr3Al2O6 and alpha-Sr4Al2O7, only ΔH_form,ox(298.15 K) is printed. Use ΔG_form,ox(T)=ΔH_form,ox(298.15 K), equivalent to ΔS_form,ox=ΔCp_form,ox=0 (Neumann-Kopp). This is provisional and separate from fusion.
brisi_entropies.entropy_bound_source: Maximum absolute measured oxide-formation entropy per mole oxide from Jacob & Shreyas 2018: max(25.376/3, 25.744/7) = 8.458666667 J mol^-1 oxide K^-1.
brisi_entropies.derivation: Premise: Brisi & Abbattista print only ΔH_form,ox(298.15 K); take ΔS_form,ox=ΔCp_form,ox=0. Algebra: H_complex(T)=ΣνH_oxide(T)+ΔH_form,ox; S_complex(T)=ΣνS_oxide(T); therefore G_complex(T)=ΣνG_oxide(T)+ΔH_form,ox. Units: convert the printed kJ/mol to J/mol before combining with JANAF J/mol and T·S in J/mol. Sanity: this exactly reproduces the printed −97.7 ± 4.2 and −81.4 ± 5.4 kJ/mol formation enthalpies at 298.15 K; the entropy assumption remains provisional.

phase_diagram_markers_K.source: Experimental values only from Ganits et al. 1979, as tabulated in Ye et al. 2007 Table 4; no optimized interactions used.

candidate_provenance.excluded_inputs: No Stolyarova, Vorozhtcov, Lopatin, Shugurov, Tyurnina, or Balabanova KEMS data were used. Ye et al. 2007 optimized liquid parameters were not used.
